The President has been pleased to appoint the following persons to be Ministers with effect from the 7th December, 1954

Shri M. Ganesh Rao, an officer of the Indian Customs Service, is appointed as Collector of Customs and Central Excise, French Establishments in India, Pondicherry, with effect from the 1st November 1954 and until further orders.
Mr. E. C. Sankar is appointed Controller of Imports and Exports at Pondicherry with jurisdiction over the area covered by the French Establishments in India with immediate effect

The Central Government hereby appoints Shri Mohammed Hamid Ali Khan, retired Sessions Judge, Hyderabad, as the claims Commissioner to deal with all claims for compensation arising out of the accident resulting from the derailment of 319 Up Train on the 27th September 1954, between Jangaon and Raghunathpalli, Stations on the Central Railway.
The President has been pleased to appoint Shri Khandubhai Kasanji Desai to be a Cabinet Minister with effect from the forenoon of the 10th September, 1954

In pursuance of Clause (s) of sub-section (1) of Section 27A of the Insurance Act, 1938 (TV of 1938), the Central Government hereby declares the undermentioned securities to be approved investments for the purposes of the said section
Shri V. V. Giri has on the forenoon of the 7th September 1954 vacated the office of Minister of the Council of the President.
The President has been pleased to appoint Shri Ajit Prasad Jain to be a Cabinet Minister with effect from the 11th August 1954.

In pursuance of clause (3) of Article 158 of the Constitution of India read with Article 238 thereof, the President is hereby pleased to direct that for the period from the afternoon of the 28th April 1954 during which he exercises the powers of the Rajpramukh of the State of Madhya Bharat

Public information that the President is pleased to recognise Commodore His Highness Maharaja Shri Sir Krishna Kumarsinhji Bhavsinhji, K.C.S.I., Maharaja of Bhavnagar, as the person competent to exercise the powers of the Rajpramukh

Recognise Brigadier His Highness Maharao Shri Sir Bhim Singhji Bahadur, K.C.S.I., Maharao of Kotah, as the person competent to exercise the powers of the Rajpramukh in relation to the State of Rajasthan during the absence from India

It Is hereby notified for public information that the President has been pleased to recognise His Highness Maharaja Yeshwant Rao Sadasiva Rao Pawar, Maharaja of Dowas (Junior), as the person competent to exercise the powers of the Rajpramukh in relation to the State of Madhya Bharat
Ministry of Rehabilitation-Shri Tek Chand, M.P., has been permitted to resign from the membership of the Insurance Claims Board, with effect from the 14th April 1954.

The Central Government hereby appoints Shri Ram Nagina Singh, I.A.S., District Magistrate, Gorakhpur, as the Claims Commissioner to deal with all claims for compensation arising out of the accident due to an explosion in a third class compartment of No. 313 Katihar-Kanpur Passenger Train at Jagatbela on the 31st March 19S4 on the North-Eastern Railway.

Appoints Sardar Kul Bhushan, District and Sessions Judge, Bhatinda, as the Claims Commissioner to deal with all claims for compensation arising out of the accident resulting from the derailment of 4 UP Passenger train on 4-1-1954 between Bhatinda and Phus Mandi stations on the Northern Railway
